notes: Clean pass, zero findings. Prior finding l1-run4-001 verified resolved: all three amendment sites (SPEC.md §5.1 rule 2 line 174, §7 constraint 1 line 252, §11 note 4 line 322) now state the slice-then-drop-trailing-high-surrogate behavior that sanitizeTrackingValue ships (utils.js:31-40), and the code is unchanged from the sanctioned fa51c91a5 fix. One completeness check on the amendment: the shipped condition drops ANY trailing 0xD800-0xDBFF code unit after the slice, not only one provably 'left when the slice splits a surrogate pair', and it never drops a trailing lone LOW surrogate (0xDC00-0xDFFF); both cases are unreachable from real input — slicing a valid pair can only strand the HIGH half, and browser location.search is a USVString (lone surrogates already replaced with U+FFFD before the helper sees them) — so the amendment's invariant sentence ('a value must never end in an unpaired surrogate') accurately holds for every reachable input; not a finding. Repo verified at fc3f047f9 on attribution-work-qa with a clean tree; HEAD file contents match the pre-dumped diff for all focus files. React key={key} on the per-key utm_data inputs has no DOM/wire effect (React list key, not an HTML attribute) — not a deviation from §5.3's naming contract. Settled items honored and not re-flagged: decode-uri-component phantom dependency (LOW list), bracket-containing utm_data keys 400ing the SSO POST (M3), uncapped key length (LOW list), sanitizeTrackingValue non-string passthrough (LOW list).
